records.title: BASIC-Prefetcher: Bin-based Address and Size-Informed Caching for AI-Driven SSD Workloads
records.reason: Weak scope fit: abstract covers six workloads and LLM traces as one workload family; article details are needed to verify whether inference-specific serving effects are central.

records.title: CRAFT: Fine-Tuning Pre-hoc Explainability in AI-native 6G RAN
records.reason: CRAFT reduces compute/energy for fine-tuning SLMs for 6G reasoning; the contribution and reported energy comparison are training-stage.

records.title: Text Capability Loss in Vision-Language Adaptation: An Attention-Sink Diagnosis
records.reason: The paper diagnoses text-capability loss caused by VLM adaptation and tests training-time interventions; no inference cost reduction is studied.

records.title: Compile, Don't Memorize: A Context Compilation Architecture (CCA) for In-Context Learning
records.reason: Weak fit: primary contribution is ICL task success and compiler/checklist tooling; full system substantially increases online tokens and extra LLM calls. Evaluation is CL-bench-specific and its questions/schema are coupled.

records.title: A Unified Mechanistic Analysis of Knowledge- and Safety-Based Refusals
records.reason: The work analyzes mechanisms of knowledge- and safety-based refusals, not inference efficiency.
